mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:tracking author toggle follows the shared getter sequence without creating revision markup
outcomes: Getter sequence, retained author after disable, unchanged held text; no authored revisions in main text.
gaps: No output-path reopen or independent rendering in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:enabled setting persists through file reopen with session-only author and complete graph custody
outcomes: Enabled output path reopen, empty author, relationship/type, explicit flag, disabled path reopen and unrelated-member bytes.
gaps: Does not independently render or inspect Office UI; graph checks and disabled reopen are scoped.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:custom settings path and prefix retain sibling XML bytes while insertion obeys settings order
outcomes: Custom path and namespace retain exact sibling source while inserted flag follows settings order.
gaps: UTF-16 and BOM rows covered separately; byte reopen only in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:missing false state and all supported on-off spellings preserve no-op bytes
outcomes: Absent false state and seven on/off lexical forms retain byte-identical no-op archives; empty settings root supports enable.
gaps: Lexical rows are a native loop, not distinct inventory declarations; no separate saved paths.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:protection, ambiguous or malformed settings refuse before package and author changes
outcomes: Protected, duplicate, malformed, misplaced and out-of-order settings refuse enable/disable without author or byte changes.
gaps: Only stated malformed combinations; path outputs and arbitrary extensions untested.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:external duplicate orphan wrong-root wrong-type and shared settings graphs refuse unchanged
outcomes: External, duplicate, orphan, wrong-root/type, shared-owner and name-collision graphs refuse enable atomically.
gaps: This declaration attempts enable only; dual enable/disable is tested by shared acceptance.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:invalid authors and stale main snapshots refuse without touching settings or invoking coercion
outcomes: Blank, XML-unsafe, invalid-type authors and stale main snapshots refuse with exact bytes; coercion not called.
gaps: Native author/setter and stale-snapshot cases exceed the shared invalid-author rows; no generic proxy guarantee.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:write and serialization faults restore settings graph plus the previous session author
outcomes: Injected write and serialization faults restore archive and prior author for absent/existing settings.
gaps: Native fault timing differs from explicit shared part/relationship stages; no crash-durability evidence.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:UTF16 settings retain encoding through enable disable and reopen
outcomes: UTF-16 settings retain BOM, enabled/disabled state after reopen and unrelated-member bytes.
gaps: Byte reopen only; no output-path or original sibling-XML assertion in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:canonical toggle selects one case and detects incorrect intermediate and final values
outcomes: Canonical getter case executes once; altered expected values and corrupted author/state fail without undefined steps.
gaps: Wrapper evidence is getter-only; no saved settings or refusal credit.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:the saved preference never silently converts ordinary Bun text mutations into tracked replacements
outcomes: Enabled preference persists alongside ordinary text edit with no revisions after reopen and empty author.
gaps: This native declaration omits opaque-part byte assertions; shared acceptance adds them.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-tracking-settings.test.ts:a fault after settings relationship creation rolls back all metadata and author state
outcomes: Fault after relationship write restores exact archive, prior author and absent settings part.
gaps: Only late relationship-write stage; no process-crash test.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/tracking-settings-outcomes.test.ts:all seven shared tracking settings contracts execute every one of 24 expanded cases
outcomes: All seven shared scenarios execute exactly24 expanded cases with no failures, undefined or ambiguous steps.
gaps: Runtime outcomes delegated to pinned acceptance bindings; no other consumer credit.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/tracking-settings-outcomes.test.ts:incorrect tracking persistence and ordinary-edit expected values fail observable assertions
outcomes: Wrong reopened flag/text expected values fail with no undefined or ambiguous steps.
gaps: Controls mutate only persistence and plain-edit expectations, not every refusal stage.
